name: Quantum Value Specification
definition: A strategy to determine the length quantum $\tau$ and field value quantum $\zeta$ (abbreviated $\varsigma$ in error formulas) by minimizing a relative quantization error estimate $Q_D$ while guarding against integer overflow.
summary: Quantum Value Specification determines optimal quantization parameters for SPH fields by minimizing relative error, distinguished by analytically deriving length quantum via convexity and coupling field quantum to integer overflow constraints.
